findings.problem: Because the hint uses the word 'accusation', it invites 'la acusación', which is also a correct Spanish answer, so the card has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: a legal count against someone, as in to drop the charges (not the general word for accusation)

back.es: charge (a formal accusation); also position, post, responsibility
back.example: The police withdrew the charges against him.

note: In this sense the word usually appears in the plural (los cargos), which the example already shows.
